# Accounts & cost

Several AI accounts with failover, usage and quota, context compaction, and deferred tools to keep prompts small.

Pack id `accounts`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/ai-accounts`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/ai-accounts/README.md) — Per-account Codex, Claude, OpenCode Go and Command Code provider instances, plus Cursor quota, for DeepSeek Harness, in the spirit of T3 Code.
2. [`@dshfiles/usage`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/usage/README.md) — Request log and cost, token, cache and latency charts built from DSH session logs, indexed incrementally into SQLite.
3. [`@dshfiles/context-compaction`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/context-compaction/README.md) — Chunked compaction backend that keeps summary requests within the model context window.
4. [`@dshfiles/tool-search`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/tool-search/README.md) — Opt-in per-agent progressive discovery of native tools

## Prerequisites

1. An AI account is configured.

## Key settings

1. **Fail over to the next account when one runs out**: Settings entry `ai-accounts`, field `failover`.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Accounts & cost under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `accounts`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs accounts` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
